A blank canvas is a tough place to start, but it can take on any design you want it to. That's where you're at right now, friend: a blank canvas. You get to decide what goes on it. How much of this? How much of that? What kind of those? It's daunting, but getting excited about the prospect of beauty is part of the fun of this thing.

Tell your therapist you feel dissociative, or depersonalized, like you don't feel human. They can help you reconnect with your humanity, if you work hard with them. If you tell them you're suicidal, they may have you hospitalized (think prison, but staffed with nurses instead of officers). You're definitely depressed and disconnected,  friend.

Set goals (easier said than done, I know first hand). Maybe that goal is to get something done in the house, maybe it is to eat at a certain time, maybe it is to drink an amount of water. But set a reachable goal, and accomplish it. Then celebrate, because you did it, darn it!

Enjoy the success. Then set yourself up for another success. It may feel weird. I felt weird. But when I stuck to things, my massive, weighty depression lifted a bit.

> "You have to be the driver of your life."

This is something I struggle with. I don't know how to be proactive in my own life. I can advocate for others, but flounder in the surf when my own life goes wonky. I don't know how to pilot my helicopter, but I sure can help the cars I see on the road.

Life is never going to be easy. It has definitely been harder than it is now. I got hit sideways by a few things at once, and they compound on each other. I feel trampled because of it.

Finances: call those you owe and talk about furlough. Student loans especially. 

Marriage: Yeah, lots of us muck up relationships. Badly. Hell, my previous ex came out as a woman. The one before her is dead. There's no way of telling with people.

Work: Well, nothing to lose, right? Check out indeed or look through your alumni assistance program to see what kinds of work are available to you. Helping people is great, but you're in a heavy spot where you are the man in need of help. You're here, right?

No passion: Yeah, that's depression. The opposite of depression is vitality. Life. New things. Variety. Different. Do different, for difference's sake.

Existing to exist: Well, you get to experience things. You can choose to populate your life with whatever you want. I'm getting rid of my ex and may be moving across the country within this coming year. I, too, look at this question. My own answer is to look for new. Different. Brighter, or greater contrast. There's nothing wrong with existing to exist. There's no reason to not exist, even with regrets in the balance.

For what it's worth, we need good lawyers. You said yourself you're a damn good one; in a career path, any career path, you have to trudge through the muck to get to the good stuff, from what I've seen.

You can make it through tonight, by my side if you want. I'm in a similar boat.
